models_evaluated: PuRe pupillometer (smartphone-based computational pupillometry, PuRe Score)

links.outcome: Stability of AI-derived PuRe Score versus standard pupil parameters across ambient light conditions (4-1,200 lux)
links.effect: Standard PLR parameters varied up to 133% with light (p<0.001); PuRe Scores were stable: median 2.64 in dim vs 2.42 in bright light (p=0.449; r=-0.026).
links.quote: Standard pupillary light reflex parameters showed high light dependence with variations up to 133% (p<0.001), whereas PuRe Scores remained stable with medians of 2.64 in dim light versus 2.42 in bright light (p=0.449; r=-0.026).

screen.reason: Prospective clinical pilot evaluation of a smartphone-based AI computational pupillometry tool in a neuro-ICU measuring pupil reactivity across lighting conditions, focusing on device/diagnostic performance rather than a specific deployment guardrail practice.
